response.sql: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT c.state_county_province, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM Accounts AS a JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), state_shares AS (SELECT account_count, 1.0 * account_count / SUM(account_count) OVER () AS share FROM state_counts), compared AS (SELECT account_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM state_shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(account_count), 0) AS combined_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_excess FROM compared WHERE share > overall_average_share;
